title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse a searchFields override naming no field instead of reading it as absent
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27484

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the data doors (`GET /data/:object`, `POST /data/:object/query`, `GET /data/:object/export`, and every other caller of `findData`) refuse a `searchFields` value that names no field, which they answered 200 over the default search set before. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` already teaches "Omit it to search the object's declared `searchableFields`", and no skill emits an empty override; the two docs pages that list the search refusals are updated here (`content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：查询里写了 `$searchFields` 却一个字段都没给（空串、只有逗号、空数组，或对象形 `search.fields` 为空）时，数据接口现在回 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 并点名参数，跟 `$select=` 一样；导出接口同样拒收。
- **为什么改**：以前这种值被当成“没写”，搜索悄悄扫了对象的全部默认搜索字段，调用方本想收窄范围，结果拿到更宽的结果，界面上看不出任何异常。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响发了空 `searchFields` 的 API 调用方（Console 与自带视图插件都只在至少有一个字段时才发）；引擎直接调用不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts`（拒收那一段）、`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`（export 不再把空值当缺省）、`packages/objectql/src/query-expression-conformance.test.ts`（有意翻转的钉子）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts`，预期 4 个用例全过（列表、POST、导出三个门回 400，对照组照旧）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（进队前欠一次契约复核）。

## What changes

- **`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`** (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts`): an override that names no field used to `return` (read as ABSENT); it now throws `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `param` set to the caller's spelling and the message `Query parameter 'PARAM' names no field; got VALUE. …` — the envelope `projectionFieldsValue` gives `$select` (#26644). It covers the standalone slot in every spelling (`$searchFields`, `searchFields`, string or array) and the object-form `search.fields`, because the gate is the one place both reach. It runs before the field-map lookup, so a registry-less host refuses too. Absent stays absent: the door calls the gate only when a value was sent. On the list and query doors the refusal holds with or without a `search` term: `GET /data/:object?$searchFields=` alone answered 200 before and is 400 now, as a non-empty override naming an unknown field already was; the export route alone still ignores `searchFields` sent without `search`.
- **`quotedQueryValue`** (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`): exported from the module (not from the package index) so the gate quotes the refused value exactly as the projection refusal does. One word in the hot file, beside `projectionFieldsValue`; no other line of `protocol.ts` moves.
- **Export route** (`rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`): `searchFields=` and `searchFields=,` are kept as the empty list instead of being dropped, so `findData`'s gate refuses them on this route too. The route still ignores `searchFields` sent without `search`, as before.
- **Two pins flipped on purpose** (triage ruling 6500648325, option A):
  - `objectql/src/query-expression-conformance.test.ts` — "an empty override is ABSENT, not malformed" becomes "an override naming no field is refused, not read as absent": `''`, `','`, `' , '`, `[]`, `$searchFields: ''`, and object-form `fields: []` / `''` each answer `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the slot; a search with no override still answers the default scan.
  - `objectql/src/engine-search-empty-set.test.ts` — the junction leg `{ search: 'Dune', searchFields: '' }` now asserts the door's refusal (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `param: 'searchFields'`) and keeps its point: no `lib_loan` read, so no silent widening to every row. The other two legs still assert the engine's junction refusal unchanged.
  - Why both flip: both pins drive `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#findData`, the same door `GET /data/:object` hands `req.query` to, so refusing at that door and keeping them could not both hold (dev report 6499580381, ruling 6500648325).
- **New door pin** `rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts`: real `RestServer` → `findData` → `ObjectQL` → sqlite. GET list (`$searchFields=`, `=,`, `= , `, unprefixed `searchFields=`), POST query (`searchFields: []`, object-form `fields: []`) and the csv export (`searchFields=`, `=,`) each answer 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the spelling, with zero reads of the object; controls (named override narrows, absent scans the default set, on all three doors) unchanged.
- Docs: the refusal table in `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` and the search callout in `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` name the new answer.
- Changeset `.changeset/27484-blank-search-fields-refused.md` (`patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required`).

## Acceptance notes

- Branch `claude/project-thread-jmw8xb` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch, named in claim 6499488942; it carries no issue number.
- The export route's json format writes its opening `[` before the first `findData`, so a `findData` refusal there (this one, and the existing `searchFields=nope` one) lands as a truncated json stream rather than a clean 400; csv and xlsx answer the envelope. Not changed here; filed as #27682.
- The published declarations still admit the value this door refuses: `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields`, `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields`, `QuerySchema.searchFields` and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` accept `''` and `[]`. So on `POST /data/:object/query` the sibling `select: []` is the body schema's `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` while `searchFields: []` is the gate's `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. Narrowing the declarations (and the engine question) is follow-up #27683.
- `engine.find()` / `engine.count()` called directly still read an empty `searchFields` as absent (the engine posture; `protocol-record-reads.ts`'s palette sweep never sends an empty one).
- Producers checked: `ui/packages/data-objectstack`, `plugin-list` `ListView.tsx`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-gantt` all send `$searchFields` / `searchFields` only when the list has at least one entry.
- Hot file: the only open PR touching `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is #27535; `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against its head 585e6198 is clean. No open PR touches the other changed files.
